name: Dr Maria Syed
title: Psychologist
description: I'm Dr Maria Syed, an AHPRA registered psychologist and member of the Australian Psychological Society. I hold a Doctorate in Psychology and support adolescents and adults with concerns including anxiety, low mood, emotional regulation, self-esteem, relationships, trauma, burnout and neurodivergence.
specialties: Diverse genders, Adult survivors of sexual abuse, Diverse sexualities, Post Traumatic Stress Disorder (PTSD), Sexual abuse

name: Helen Killmier
title: Psychologist
description: Helen is the founder of Guidestar. Guidestar is both a private practice and works with people and/or families experiencing disability, mental health concerns, neurodiversity, trauma or other issues.
specialties: Diverse sexualities, Adult survivors of sexual abuse, Dissociative Identity Disorder, Diverse genders, EMDR, Schema Therapy

name: Alix Quirke
title: Psychologist
address: Suite 4, 218 Upper Heidelberg Road, 221 Lower Heidelberg Road
description: I work with school-aged children, adolescents, adults and older adults experiencing a range of mental health concerns. I have a particular interest in anxiety (social anxiety, generalised anxiety, panic disorder, agoraphobia, OCD) and depression (including geriatric), perfectionism, stress and burnout, bullying, life adjustments, school-based difficulties, relationship difficulties, and family issues. I offer an inclusive and accepting practice for LGBTIQA+, neuro- and culturally-diverse people and those that care for them. I practise in modalities such as CBT; CBT-ERP, IFS therapy, Systemic Family Therapy, Cognitive Processing Therapy (CPT), Dialectical Behavioural Therapy (DBT), EMDR and incorporate values-based, mindfulness and play practices.
specialties: Diverse genders, Gender Dysphoria, Post Traumatic Stress Disorder (PTSD), Schema Therapy, EMDR

name: Joanna Tran
title: Psychologist

name: Casey Hosking
title: Clinical Psychologist
description: Available for in-person sessions at 8-10 Mansfield St, Thornbury, or via Telehealth. Casey is a clinical psychologist and researcher with 15 years of experience working, studying, and volunteering in the field. Casey works primarily with adults facing concerns including (but not limited to) depression, anxiety, neurodiversity, difficulties with self concept or identity, relationship concerns, and exploration of gender and sexuality.
specialties: Sexual difficulties, Diverse genders, Gender Dysphoria, Sex worker issues, Adult survivors of sexual abuse, Diverse sexualities, Sexual abuse, EMDR

name: Soph Marsland
title: Psychologist
address: Level 1, 50 Main Street, *Clinic rooms have stairs
description: Soph is passionate about helping people build rich meaningful lives. With warmth and authenticity, Soph supports clients to develop insight and learn skills to manage the difficult thoughts, feelings, memories and other experiences that come with being human. Soph combines ACT with Schema Therapy and compassion-based approaches. Soph has special interest in working with clients experiencing all types of anxiety, mood problems, obsessions/compulsions, psychosis, trauma, and perinatal issues. She is a proud LGBTQIA+ community supporter.
specialties: Post Traumatic Stress Disorder (PTSD), Adult survivors of sexual abuse, Diverse genders, Diverse sexualities, Sexual abuse, Schema Therapy

name: Dr Katie Wyman
title: Psychologist
description: Katie is a Clinical and Counselling Psychologist with 20+ years experience. She works with adults presenting with a wide array of issues and needs. She uses Schema Therapy and Acceptance and Commitment Therapy (ACT) in flexible and creative ways and is informed by attachment theory and compassion focussed therapies.
specialties: Adult survivors of sexual abuse, Diverse sexualities, Sexual abuse, Diverse genders, Post Traumatic Stress Disorder (PTSD), Schema Therapy

name: Wen Lynn Ng
